purpose: Second bounded batch of descriptive hero-kit capability analysis, following the accepted five-hero pilot schema.

scope.season_skill_observations: retained_as_distinct_secondary_source_context_only; not modeled as Season Charm or active mechanics

provenance.source_representation: V4 paraphrased extraction summaries, not verbatim ability text
provenance.direct_page_retrieval: not_claimed_for_all_records; Batch 25 recaptures use indexed primary-source content where direct page opens returned cache misses
provenance.source_tags: preserved separately on each mechanic as captured source metadata; unknown remains null
provenance.unknown_values: remain unknown; absence of a modeled field is not evidence that an effect does not exist
provenance.source_manifest_note: The shared source manifest records the original first-pass capture batches and is not exhaustive of later section-level recapture evidence visible in V4. Ability-level source attribution therefore follows each V4 section source_evidence record and the cited extraction batch document.

mechanics.effect_summary: Summons Mr. Carlyle to a selected tile; he inherits Cecia's stats and gains bonus max HP that decays over time.
Mr. Carlyle entangles enemies within 2 tiles, preventing movement and actions.
Entangled enemies take damage over time.
Recasting the Ultimate while Mr. Carlyle is present restores him to max HP and repeats the entangle effect.
Entangles one enemy, dealing damage over time and preventing movement and actions.
mechanics.target_selector: single_enemy; exact selection rule not stated

mechanics.effect_summary: Cecia absorbs Phys DEF and Magic DEF from the target; the stolen stats are shared with Mr. Carlyle.
Increases Cecia's and Mr. Carlyle's ATK SPD for 8 seconds.
At a stated skill level, Mr. Carlyle's next normal attack is replaced by a quake affecting a 2-tile area and granting Life Drain.
The 2-tile area quake grants Mr. Carlyle Life Drain.
Cecia and Mr. Carlyle gain DEF Penetration.
Cecia's next normal attack is enhanced; later levels increase its damage.
Reduces the number of normal attacks required to trigger Agonizing Puncture.
Grants 500 Initial Energy.
Cecia permanently steals stats from entangled enemies; the stolen stats are shared with Mr. Carlyle.
Taunts an enemy for 3 seconds; the target-selection priority is the enemy currently targeting the weakest ally.
Granny Dahnie restores HP when using Angry Taunt.
Granny fires Parasitic Seeds at the triggering enemy and deals damage.
Reduces the target's Haste for 6 seconds.
Seed Cannon reduces the target's ATK; the exact base reduction value is not present in the summary.
Increases Granny Dahnie's Phys DEF and Magic DEF.
Restores Granny Dahnie's HP over time.
For 3 seconds, enemies within 2 tiles of Parasitic Grass cannot move or act.
Affected enemies lose 25 Energy each second.
Affected enemies lose HP equal to at least 60% ATK per second; the summary gives total HP loss as 130% ATK per second.
Granny Dahnie recovers HP equal to the HP loss inflicted by Parasitic Grass.
Granny Dahnie is unaffected while Parasitic Grass exists.
Seed Cannon restores HP to Granny Dahnie when it fires.
Firing a seed also restores Energy.
Firing a seed grants a large temporary Haste increase.
Strengthens Seed Cannon's ATK reduction on the target.
Knocks back enemies within 2 tiles.
Binds the nearest enemy, deals damage and immobilizes it for 5 seconds.
Exposes the enemy's weakness after stat-reduction debuffs have been applied by more than three different allied heroes.
Indris' normal attacks deal additional true damage against exposed targets.
Indris fires three arrows with target-priority rules; the exact priority sequence is not detailed in the summary.
Spellbane Shot's arrow silences its target.
Disables the target's stat buffs for 8 seconds; this effect does not work on Bosses.
Permanently reduces the target's Phys DEF and Magic DEF by 20%; the effect does not stack.
At a higher skill level, can deal true damage based on the target's max HP to an exposed-weakness target.
Increases Indris' ATK SPD for 6 seconds; higher ranks improve the bonus.
At higher ranks, normal attacks also reduce the target's Phys DEF.
For 5 seconds after Arcane Binding hits, normal attacks can trigger exposed-weakness bonus damage without a cooldown.
At Enhance Force level 2, arrows deal additional physical damage based on target max HP after Indris breaks a weakness.
Each normal attack adds a stack of ATK SPD and normal-attack damage, up to 10 stacks.
The enemy takes damage and becomes Drowning after the stated control-duration threshold.
Nerion deals increased damage to enemies affected by Drowning.
Empowers Nerion with ATK and ATK SPD for 12 seconds.
Deluge deals damage that bounces between enemies affected by Drowning.
The enhanced normal attack deals damage, knocks back the target and stuns it.
Throws a spear at the area with the most enemies and damages nearby enemies.
A current erupts, launches enemies and deals a second hit.
Applies Drowning to the rearmost enemy.
mechanics.target_selector: rearmost_enemy; exact formation is not predicted

mechanics.effect_summary: The affected enemy has reduced ATK and Haste and takes periodic damage while controlled.
Grants Nerion 1000 Energy and permanently empowers him when the stated Drowning threshold is met.
Grants Penetration while Nerion is above an Energy threshold; the exact threshold and value are not present in the summary.
Sends a Bulb to each non-summoned ally; Bulbs periodically heal their host.
Bulbs store excess healing; when stored healing reaches a threshold, the Bulb blooms into a Bulbsprite.
The Bulbsprite permanently increases its host's ATK.
Existing Bulbs and Bulbsprites remain active after Solise is defeated, but cannot grow or respond to her after that point.
Heals the two allies with the lowest HP.
Healing an ally who already has a Bulbsprite grants that ally a permanent shield, subject to a cap.
When a Bulb blooms, its host gains permanent Phys DEF and Magic DEF.
Further excess healing upgrades the Bulbsprite up to three times and adds permanent ATK to its host; maximum level also grants max HP.
Releases three waves of healing across the battlefield; each wave restores 140% ATK HP to affected allies.
When a Bulbsprite is healed, it emits a water ring from its host that damages all enemies.
Solise is unaffected while casting Life's Embrace.
During Life's Embrace, Bulbsprite damage triggers additional damage based on total excess healing stored during the Bulbsprite phase, subject to an ATK cap.
The first ally to fall below 40% HP is healed for 160% of Solise's ATK as HP.
The same first ally to fall below 40% HP receives a shield equal to 160% of Solise's ATK.

team_functions.rationale: Mr. Carlyle and Cecia provide repeated damage opportunities, including damage over time and a conditional area quake; exact output depends on summon presence and skill level.
Earth's Offering can amplify the attack speed of Cecia and her summon, and its enhanced Carlyle attack grants Life Drain.
Entangle can prevent affected enemies from moving or acting; its availability depends on the relevant ability effect and target proximity.
Mr. Carlyle is a summon linked to Cecia's stats, and entangled targets can enable defensive-stat absorption and sharing.
Granny has several self-preservation effects, including healing, defensive stats and a temporary unaffected state.
Taunt, action/movement denial, Energy loss and Haste/ATK reductions disrupt opposing actions and output.
Seed Cannon retaliates with damage and Threshold of Jade inflicts repeated HP loss while its area effect persists.
Indris gains conditional true-damage and max-HP-based damage opportunities against exposed targets, with a separate Rivalry Mode normal-attack stacking effect.
Knockback, immobilization, silence and temporary stat-buff denial provide multiple forms of control/disruption.
Indris has a conditional exposed-weakness sequence and persistent/conditional defensive-stat reduction; exposed weakness depends on debuffs from more than three distinct allies.
Nerion combines area damage and repeated hits with additional damage against Drowning targets and Deluge's conditional bounce behavior.
Control effects can contribute to the Drowning condition; knockback, stun and airborne provide further disruption.
Nerion's Drowning state and threshold-based permanent empowerment form a conditional kit-specific sequence.
Solise distributes periodic and burst healing to allies, including targeted healing for the two lowest-HP allies and a Rivalry Mode threshold response.
Bulbsprite progression grants permanent defensive stats and conditional shields to allied hosts.
Solise's Ultimate and Enhance Force can convert Bulbsprite healing interactions and stored excess healing into enemy damage.
The Bulb/Bulbsprite system stores excess healing and converts it into persistent ally progression; existing units can persist after Solise is defeated but no longer grow or respond to her.

interactions.description: Cecia's entangle can deny movement and actions to affected enemies; this describes her own control capability, not a guaranteed team follow-up.
Earth's Offering can increase both Cecia's and Mr. Carlyle's ATK SPD while Carlyle is present.
Granny can reduce Haste/ATK and deny Energy/actions under their respective triggers; no target or timing outcome is predicted.
Threshold of Jade converts its HP-loss effect into self-recovery for Granny while the grass exists.
Indris can expose an enemy's weakness after the stated multi-ally debuff condition; the presence and timing of those debuffs are not predicted.

interactions.conditions: Spellbane Shot must hit; target must not be a Boss
interactions.description: Spellbane Shot can disable target stat buffs for 8 seconds, except against Bosses.
Sustained control can satisfy Nerion's Drowning trigger; whether a target remains controlled long enough is match-dependent.
Nerion deals increased damage to Drowning enemies and can use Deluge's conditional bounce effect against them.
Bulbs provide periodic healing to eligible allied hosts and can accumulate excess healing toward Bulbsprite growth.
Floral Favor can grant a permanent capped shield to an ally with a Bulbsprite when that ally is healed.
